genai.label: Generative AI
genai.def: AI that produces text and images: language modelling (the technology behind chatbots such as ChatGPT) and image generation.

allapps.label: All AI
allapps.def: AI as a whole: nine application areas, from image and speech recognition, translation and reading comprehension to games, plus the two generative ones.
